setup: Return/throw every built-in failure category under WithRetry.
assertion: Only approved step failures/timeouts retry; definition, cancellation, deadline, type, lease-integrity, and authoring failures remain excluded.

setup: Call CompleteWithin twice in both modes.
assertion: Second call eagerly throws one SFE-AUTH-DEADLINE-001 with second location primary and first related; original deadline remains selected.

setup: Crash/restart across workflow, wait, and step deadlines and ContinueAsNew generations.
assertion: Absolute deadlines persist; workflow deadline bounds all work and does not reset, while a new generation inherits the approved workflow deadline semantics.

setup: Timeout a token-ignoring ordinary body while a retry begins and both mutate state.
assertion: Only the winning detached copy commits; late results are fenced while their physical throttle/transient slots remain occupied until return.

setup: Crash at every boundary before/after first dispatch.
assertion: StepOperationId, positive AttemptNumber, optional absolute deadline, and in-flight marker commit before dispatch.
expectedRed: Full durable attempt coordinate is absent.

setup: Lose host/response before outcome commit and redispatch under competing drivers.
assertion: Physical redispatch reuses operation ID, attempt number, deadline, and request fingerprint without consuming budget; one outcome wins.
expectedRed: Uncertain redispatch coordinate reuse is incomplete.

setup: Commit eligible failure/timeout then schedule retry.
assertion: AttemptNumber increments only after committed eligibility while StepOperationId stays stable; maxAttempts includes initial attempt.

setup: Exercise maxAttempts one/two with restart after an already-expired attempt deadline.
assertion: Expired attempt times out without dispatch; one exhausts at attempt one, two commits attempt two only after the first timeout.
expectedRed: Expired replay budget handling is absent.

setup: Crash before/after external create response and retry the adapter.
assertion: The same StepOperationId and request fingerprint create-or-observe at most one logical effect despite ambiguous responses.

setup: Visit the same authored step across loop iterations, ForEach items, Parallel branches, and ContinueAsNew generations.
assertion: Each logical occurrence gets a distinct StepOperationId while redispatch/retry inside one occurrence retains it.
